function.description: Redeem a MATURED Pendle principal token (PT) for its accounting asset (~1:1) after expiry. Approval-gated; pins the canonical Pendle Router. If Pendle's pricing service is unavailable it falls back to a direct on-chain redeem that delivers SY (the wrapped yield-bearing token), NOT the underlying asset — the result names it as `deliveredAsset`; unwrap it with pendle.sy.redeem to finish the exit. REQUIRES a fresh matching pendle.pt.quote first.
function.name: pendle__pt_redeem

amountIn.description: Amount of PT to redeem in human-readable units.

chain.description: Chain slug or id — one of Pendle's 11 chains (e.g. 'ethereum', 'arbitrum', 'base', 'bsc').

tokenIn.description: The matured PT CONTRACT ADDRESS to redeem.
